caseNameFull: Stephen M. Egan, in Error v. The State of New Jersey
summary: In error to the Court of Errors and Appeals of the State of New Jersey.
attorneys: Mr. John Franklin Fort for the plaintiff in error. Mr. Robert H. McCarter and Mr. Pierre P. Garven for the defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of Zeller v. New Jersey, 231 U. S. 737, and' bases cited.
